messages:
Alejandra (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — SyncForge reported their SDK fails on our header rename and payload rekey (response -> result). They need a short runway and a CI smoke test. Any low-effort compat pattern?
Connor (Eng-API): If their SDK validates keys strictly, simplest is to return both keys in the response body for a short window: {'result': ..., 'response': ...}. That keeps streaming semantics untouched and is backward-compatible.
Priya (Eng-Platform): We can gate that behind a per-partner feature-flag and add an adapter layer so only requests from SyncForge see the dual-key payload. Minimal routing change.
Hannah (PM): They asked for 21 days and a firm sunset. Also want a curl snippet to run in their CI.
Alejandra (Partnerships): Can we commit to dual-key for 3 weeks, provide Node + curl tests, and telemetry so we can measure v1 usage?
Connor (Eng-API): Yes. We'll emit metrics: syncforge.v1_only, syncforge.v2_only, syncforge.dual. Also add an opt-in header X-RDW-Dual: syncforge to let their CI force the bridge.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'll create feature-flag 'syncforge-dual-payload' and a test endpoint /compat/syncforge/smoke that returns example payloads.
Alejandra (Partnerships): Draft comms: 'We will enable a compatibility payload that includes both "response" and "result" keys for requests from SyncForge for a 21-day window starting 2025-11-15. Please run the provided CI snippet and report failures by 2025-11-22. The bridge will be removed 2025-12-06.'
Hannah (PM): Sounds good. I'll approve.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag 'syncforge-dual-payload' -> canary 2025-11-15T02:00Z. CI link: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4991
Connor (Eng-API): I'll publish the Node sample and curl snippet to a private gist and add the test harness.
Priya (Eng-Platform): I'll add dashboard panels for the three metrics and a per-region toggle if needed.
Alejandra (Partnerships): Thanks — action items: Connor/Priya implement bridge & telemetry, Hannah finalize comms, Alejandra sends partner the harness and date. We'll reconvene after canary results.
